title: Needs you
how: Only what is open for you, oldest first. Each item says what to do, links everything it needs, and gives my recommendation. It leaves this page once you have answered it here or done it.
Pick an answer under each item; a note is optional.
foot: One page, one link, kept current (his order of 2 November). The same list is kept as plain data beside it (items.json) for the advisor's checker.

sections.name: DECISION: Adopt the order of 23 November (runs to Mon 30 Nov 13:00)
why: Last week's order ends today at 13:00; work from 13:00 follows the adopted order.
Built by the advisor from the running list on 22 Nov; his later rows of that evening (installed games, GTA V, the budget table, the audit) are folded in at its end.
sections.recommendation: Yes: it puts the whole week on the measurements, so the design can close by Friday.
detail: Runs from your tap to Mon 30 Nov 13:00. A normal week: the line runs 0 to 90% to Mon 30 Nov 07:00; the advisor's cloud work takes about half, the PC about half.
The purpose: every measurement the design needs, done by Fri 27 Nov, so the design can close and the one-shot can start (plan date the Mon 7 Dec reset).

The PC's items: the measuring block, code reading what code can and the cheapest agreeing model labelling frames on the API credit, installed games first, then footage (60 h); our own build filmed and the cheap-reader trial, Monday 13:00 (3 h); live talk's delay and cost against the 2 s bar (8 h); the monthly voice-model scan (3 h); the recipe rewrite (3 h); the weekly audit, judgement first (3 h); efficiency and safety (6 h).
Also from Sunday evening's rows: the size table from inZOI's and Silent Hill 2's files before you uninstall them; GTA V measured and torn down once you install it; a small hidden-details catalogue.
Waiting until after the prototype: Kiln and the garments, then the Unreal street work.
